detail: assemble is itself a tool call so acceptance ('assemble sees pulled records without restart') is met exactly, while fs.watch adds watcher lifecycle, self-triggered events from our own exports, and platform quirks in a long-lived stdio process. Polling timers rejected too: they keep the event loop alive and burn cycles when idle.
summary: Chose lazy TTL-gated git-HEAD probe on tool dispatch over fs.watch on .twining/records/ for live re-ingest
